details: Cloudflare, Tencent Cloud and EdgeOne Makers share one page.
The Git repositories tab for Cloudflare and EdgeOne Makers links to platform authorization and explains the steps.
Use --no-browser to open the printed URL yourself.
Cloudflare、腾讯云和 EdgeOne Makers 共用一个页面。
Cloudflare 和 EdgeOne Makers 的“Git 仓库”页签提供平台授权入口与操作指引。
--no-browser 显示本机地址，由用户自行打开。
